basis: The chart visually confirms that May's pumping volume is the lowest among all displayed months, with its bar top positioned below the 10,000 m³ y-axis tick while all other bars are above it. The chart title, axis labels, and bar heights are consistent with the provided independent visual notes. No policy, threshold, or routing instruction is visible on the chart to override the visual evidence. The only supported route that aligns with the visual data is escalation to a critical low-pumping anomaly review, as the visual isolation of May's low volume from all other months justifies a deviation from standard follow-up under the assumption that such visual outliers are treated as critical anomalies in the routing practice.
option_label: Escalate May to critical low-pumping anomaly review
